claims.claim: Very sound and working fine borehole drilling machine
claims.evidence: No video or photo shows the engine running, the rig mast raising, or hydraulics operating; only static, folded-mast shots are available.

claims.claim: Buy to site condition (implying ready to drive/deploy)
claims.evidence: No odometer, no engine bay, no tyre close-ups, no proof of roadworthiness or current registration are shown.

risks.risk: Engine may not start or may have major mechanical faults
risks.proof: Video of engine starting cold, idling, and revving with visible exhaust

risks.risk: Drilling rig mast, hydraulics, and compressor may not function
risks.proof: Video of mast raising/lowering and drill rods/hydraulic levers operating under power
risks.if_unproven: price as non-functional rig, salvage/parts value only

risks.proof: Clear photo of odometer and any service record/logbook

risks.risk: Unknown chassis/rig age and model (only 'FR' lettering visible)
risks.proof: Photo of VIN/chassis plate and rig manufacturer nameplate
risks.if_unproven: price as oldest plausible generation of this rig type

risks.proof: Clear photo of number plate and current vehicle particulars/registration papers

risks.risk: Surface rust may hide structural/frame corrosion
risks.proof: Close-up photos of chassis rails, frame joints, and underside
risks.if_unproven: price as having frame rust risk, lower tier

risks.risk: Windshield stickers ('BENT PA(?)D STEERING', 'NO HAND SIGNAL') suggest known defects (bent steering, no indicators)
risks.proof: Close-up readable photo of both stickers and a video test of steering and turn signals
risks.if_unproven: price as having steering/signal faults needing repair

risks.risk: Tyre condition and interior/cab condition not assessable
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all tyre treads and full interior/dashboard shots
risks.if_unproven: price as needing tyre replacement and interior refurbishment

proof_requests: Video of engine starting and running
Video of drilling mast raising/lowering and hydraulics operating
Clear photo of VIN/chassis plate and rig manufacturer nameplate
Clear photo of number plate and current registration/roadworthiness papers
Close-up photos of chassis frame and underside for rust/structural damage
Readable close-up of windshield stickers and video of steering/turn signal function
Close-up photos of all tyres and full cab interior
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a Nissan Diesel water-well drilling rig truck, but all functional claims (engine, rig, roadworthiness) are unverifiable from the photos, so it must be priced at worst case pending the listed proof.
